# Night Gallery

> An ambient learning canvas for Samsung Tizen TVs: a serverless, fully
> self-contained signed .wgt that shows one museum-style full-screen card at
> a time — chess puzzles (solution reveals after 4 minutes), 585 concept
> cards across 14 tags, and ambient light interludes — controlled entirely
> by the TV remote.

Night Gallery targets 2021 Tizen 6.0 TVs (Chromium 76 ceiling, enforced by a
static guard). It has zero runtime dependencies; Playwright is the only
devDependency, used for headless end-to-end tests. All content, fonts, and
assets ship inside the widget — it runs with the TV's network unplugged. The
app also runs unmodified in any desktop browser by opening
`tizen/index.html` directly, no build step and no server required.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, features, remote key mapping, how to try
  it in a browser or install it on a TV.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): architecture, engineering constraints, and the
  agent workflow used to build this repo.
- [docs/CONTENT-INDEX.md](docs/CONTENT-INDEX.md): the full generated list of
  every concept card and chess puzzle, by tag.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, test gates, how to add a
  content card, and the Chromium-76 compatibility rule.
- [English site](https://cocodedk.github.io/night-gallery/)
- [Persian site](https://cocodedk.github.io/night-gallery/fa/)
- [Live browser demo](https://cocodedk.github.io/night-gallery/demo/)
